text: Quality of great tasting water.

Fits perfectly in our Whirlpool Gold side-by-side with no leaks. A fraction of the cost of the alternatives, with no sacrifice in quality. Great purchase.

*Edit on 12/16*

I changed my mind and now give this filter a 2, only because it fits. There has been some weird sort of film floating in the water since changing the filter. It reminds me of huge pieces of fish food flakes. It's thick enough to see these chunks floating around, they're about the size of finger nails and look vaguely like skin.

If I filled and emptied 3 bottles of water, the fourth one would usually be clear. I could live with that if the water tasted delicious, but it tastes exactly like chlorinated tap water. I'd rather just drink tap water because I wouldn't have to deal with the skin monsters.

This filter has had probably 20 gallons pushed through it and it's not getting any better. I'm running up to the hardware for a speedy replacement and this *new* filter is going in the trash.

Never again
